questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to a successful crown?' Mina replies:
options: A good choice of material, good preparation, and good occlusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The success of a crown depends on the material, preparation, and occlusion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will focus on these three aspects.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When to choose a zirconia crown over a metal-ceramic one?' Mina replies:
options: Zirconia offers better aesthetics but is more expensive
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Zirconia offers superior aesthetics without metal, but at a higher cost.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose zirconia for anterior teeth.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to improve crown retention?' Mina advises him:
options: Pay attention to preparation and adhesion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Retention depends on the quality of preparation and adhesion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refine my preparations.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is the difference between an inlay and an onlay?' Mina explains:
options: The onlay covers the cusps, the inlay does not
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The onlay is more conservative than a crown and reinforces the cusps.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose an onlay for this fracture.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use a bonded bridge rather than a conventional bridge?' Mina replies:
options: When the abutment teeth are healthy and we want to avoid preparation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The bonded bridge is a conservative option when the abutments do not require preparation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a bonded bridge for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to choose between a removable prosthesis and implants?' Mina replies:
options: The choice depends on bone condition, budget, and patient expectations
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The choice depends on multiple clinical and financial factors.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will discuss the options with my patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to avoid crown decementation?' Mina advises him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Decementation is often due to occlusion or preparation defects.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the occlusion before cementing.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss impressions. Mina says: 'Digital impression is more comfortable.' Sami asks: 'What is its disadvantage?'
options: It is not compatible with all materials
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The intraoral scanner has a high investment cost.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the profitability before investing.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a temporary crown?' Mina replies:
options: A temporary crown that protects the tooth while waiting for the definitive one
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The temporary protects the tooth and allows evaluation of aesthetics and function.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make a quality temporary.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with severe bruxism?' Mina replies:
options: Propose a metal-ceramic or monolithic zirconia crown
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'In case of bruxism, resistant materials like metal-ceramic or monolithic zirconia are needed.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will also prescribe a splint.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is occlusion in prosthetics?' Mina replies:
options: The contacts between upper and lower teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Occlusion is the key to prosthetic stability and masticatory function.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will work on the occlusion of every prosthesis.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to choose the color of an anterior crown?' Mina advises him:
options: With a shade guide under natural light
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A shade guide under natural light is the reliable method.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will invest in a good shade guide.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use a removable partial denture?' Mina replies:
options: To replace several teeth with a limited budget
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Partial dentures are indicated for replacing multiple teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a partial denture for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss veneers. Mina says: 'Veneers are very aesthetic.' Sami asks: 'What is their disadvantage?'
options: They are fragile and require good hygiene
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Veneers are fragile and require rigorous hygiene.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prescribe good hygiene to my patients.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a bridge that moves?' Mina advises him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A moving bridge can be due to cement failure or an occlusal problem.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the cement first.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of CAD/CAM in prosthetics?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'CAD/CAM offers speed, precision, and comfort, but requires investment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in CAD/CAM.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a removable prosthesis that irritates the gum?' Mina replies:
options: Check the adaptation and occlusal balance
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Irritations are often due to localized pressures or poor balance.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will correct the adaptation.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When to use a post and core?' Mina replies:
options: For root-treated teeth with enough coronal structure
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The post and core is indicated when the root-treated tooth retains enough structure to receive a crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the structure before deciding.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to improve the aesthetics of an anterior crown?' Mina advises him:
options: Use a pure ceramic or stratified zirconia
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pure ceramic or stratified zirconia offer the most natural aesthetics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a pure ceramic for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss prosthesis clasps. Mina says: 'Flexible clasps are more aesthetic.' Sami asks: 'What is their disadvantage?'
options: They are less resistant than metal clasps
They are more difficult to place
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Flexible clasps are aesthetic but less resistant to wear.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will choose based on use.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a crown that has come off?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The cause of the decementation must be analyzed to avoid recurrence.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the occlusion before re-cementing.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of monolithic zirconia?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Monolithic zirconia combines aesthetics and strength, ideal for high-load areas.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use monolithic zirconia for molars.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a conventional complete denture?' Mina replies:
options: A removable prosthesis replacing all teeth in an arch
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The complete denture is a removable prosthesis that replaces all teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prepare the impression well.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss the future of prosthetics. Mina says: '3D printing will evolve.' Sami asks: 'Towards what?'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: '3D printing will offer faster and more precise prostheses.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will invest in 3D printing.'

questions.question: Sami, after having mastered prosthetic materials with Mina, says: 'I am ready to take on all challenges!' Mina concludes: 'Mastery of materials is...'
options: The basis of success in prosthetics
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastery of materials is the basis of success in prosthetics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to train.'
